title: Zcash Supply Check
description: Audits user pasted Zcash chain value pool balances (the four pinned pools, integer zatoshi) against a claimed total supply: exact pool sum, non-negative pools, and the conservation identity that the four pools equal the claimed supply. Values only: it cannot read the chain and never verifies the pasted numbers are true, so chain_verified is false on every payload. Refuses non-numeric values, unknown pool names, a missing pool, an absent supply, fractional zatoshi, and over-bound values.

pools.description: Four chain value pool balances in integer zatoshi, keyed transparent, sprout, sapling, orchard. All four required; unknown keys refused, never zeroed.

transparent.description: Transparent pool balance in integer zatoshi.

sprout.description: Sprout pool balance in integer zatoshi.

sapling.description: Sapling pool balance in integer zatoshi.

orchard.description: Orchard pool balance in integer zatoshi.

claimed_supply_zat.description: The claimed total supply the identity is tested against, in integer zatoshi. Absent, fractional, or over-bound values are refused, never assumed.

input_schema_provenance: Top-level properties are exactly the policy_parameters members the kernel reads: pools, claimed_supply_zat. No required array: the kernel itself refuses absent fields (claimed_supply_zat absent, a missing pinned pool) with structured refusal payloads, so the refusal branches stay reachable through every call path.
